incidents.description: US troops leave Iraq; Kata'ib Hezbollah says it has agreed no disarmament deal and 'the resistance has won this round'.
Suspected Boko Haram fighters kill 15 or more farmers and firewood gatherers; three are missing.
incidents.note: Reuters says 'suspected Islamists'; AP says 15 dead.

incidents.description: A motorcycle bomb targets a Taliban intelligence official; ISKP claims it and the National Resistance Front also claims it.
incidents.note: Contested: two competing claims; neither authenticated; Afghan authorities have not confirmed.

incidents.place: Mokha and Bab el-Mandeb area, Yemen
incidents.description: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces say they retook areas around the Bab el-Mandeb strait; the Houthis deny losing ground.
incidents.note: Contested: government claim versus Houthi denial.

incidents.description: Mali's army, backed by Africa Corps (Russian state-run force), retakes Kidal after JNIM and FLA forces withdraw; the Soufan Center calls the gain politically important but strategically limited.
incidents.note: Kidal coordinates are the town centre.

incidents.description: Islamic State Mozambique fighters attack Christians at Ngangolo; on 10 October two Christians are beheaded near Muangaza, Mocímboa da Praia.
incidents.note: Source for the two named incidents is a weak tracker (trackingterrorism.org); the ReliefWeb monitor confirms a wave of violence in September–October only.

incidents.description: JNIM reportedly seizes army bases and posts at Tougouri, Gomboro and Diabiga.
incidents.note: Single graded aggregator that relays party claims; not independently confirmed.

incidents.place: Tessit and Oudalan, Mali/Burkina Faso border
incidents.description: JNIM and the Islamic State Sahel Province fight near Tessit and Oudalan; ISSP claims 400+ JNIM dead, unverified.
incidents.note: Exact date not established; toll unverified.

incidents.place: King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
incidents.description: A Houthi missile hits the domestic terminal; 12 killed and about 300 wounded; the Houthis claim it.
incidents.note: A follow-up strike the next day reportedly killed one more person (NPR). Airport coordinates assigned by the researcher.

incidents.description: Pakistan says TTP-linked fighters tried to cross from Afghanistan, Afghan Taliban posts opened fire, and 12 militants and Afghan personnel died; one Pakistani soldier killed.
incidents.note: Pakistani military account; Afghan authorities had not responded.

incidents.description: Suspected ISWAP fighters storm a military base; 15 soldiers and five civilian militia members reported killed, vehicles burned, troops withdraw toward Monguno.
incidents.note: First reports gave 'more than 10 soldiers and four civilians'.

incidents.place: Bakaheku mining sites, Mambasa territory, Ituri, DR Congo
incidents.description: An attack attributed to the ADF on three mining sites kills 10 people.

incidents.place: Sultan Mastura, Maguindanao del Norte, Philippines
incidents.description: Police and soldiers kill a Dawlah Islamiyah sub-leader and three followers serving arrest warrants.
incidents.note: Faction not named in the report.

incidents.description: Islamic State Sahel Province fighters attack civilian camps; at least 48 are killed (Mali's army later reports 54 bodies).
incidents.note: Coordinates are the nearest town, about 50 km away.

incidents.description: Two Western hostages (one Swiss, one Austrian) held in Niger for 18 and 21 months are freed and flown to Benghazi.
incidents.note: Holder reported as Islamic State Sahel Province; the release terms are not public.

incidents.description: Syrian forces raid a suspected Islamic State cell; two officers and five cell members killed, six arrested.
A military-escorted convoy of 1,107 fuel tankers reaches Bamako, the fourth convoy in October; JNIM's fuel blockade of the capital runs since April 2026.
Al-Shabaab ambushes Somali troops; at least 20 soldiers killed per a survivor, dozens per other reports; the army claims about 75 militants killed.
incidents.note: Tolls differ widely across sources; al-Shabaab claims 321.

incidents.place: Dharin and Qurac, Cal Miskaad mountains, Bari, Somalia
incidents.description: Puntland forces fight Islamic State in the heaviest clash of their offensive; Puntland says 57 foreign fighters and 15 soldiers died; the UAE flies a supporting drone strike.
incidents.note: Toll is a Puntland claim that VOA could not verify; coordinates are an approximate mountain area.

incidents.place: Southern Lebanon (near Shoukin, Mayfadoun and Qantara)
incidents.description: Israeli drone and air strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite the June ceasefire framework; Hezbollah leader Qassem rejects disarmament.
incidents.note: Coordinates are approximate for the Nabatieh area. Reports of Hezbollah rebuilding drone capability come from Lebanese sources cited by Times of Israel.

incidents.place: Rask and Iranshahr area, Sistan and Baluchestan, Iran
incidents.description: The Baluch coalition claims five attacks on Iranian security forces in seven days, including a mine and gunfire attack on a Guards vehicle at Rudmahi that killed five.
incidents.note: Claims by the coalition; Iranian figures for losses are lower.

note: Groups with no incident listed: no strategic-scale event was verified in the window with a usable source.
